experiments.title: Determine limestone purity by blank-corrected back-titration
experiments.title_de: Kalksteinreinheit durch Rücktitration
experiments.question: Can acid consumption recover the carbonate fraction of a carbonate–sand sample?
experiments.script:
# QA-001: Determine limestone purity by blank-corrected back-titration
# Design only: predictions below are not measured observations.
register lv3
add v1 water 100mL
add v1 HCl 0.003mol
new
add v2 water 100mL
add v2 CaCO3 0.001mol
add v2 SiO2 0.100g
add v2 HCl 0.003mol
sweep v2 1bar
wait 60s
titrate v1 NaOH 0.1M 0.2mL until ph 7 max 200
titrate v2 NaOH 0.1M 0.2mL until ph 7 max 200
inspect
experiments.expected_result: The sample consumes about 2 mmol more acid than the blank, corresponding to 1 mmol CaCO3; silica is excluded from neutralising capacity.

expected_processes.interpretation: Educational equation or schematic relationship; not a claim that every species, pathway or coupling is implemented.
Educational equation or schematic relationship; not a claim that every species, pathway or coupling is implemented.

acceptance_checks.criterion: Blank minus sample base demand is close to 2 mmol, allowing two burette increments and residual dissolved CO2.
Recovered carbonate amount agrees with the introduced amount; silica remains a separate inventory.

novelty.basis: A new experimental question or substantive controlled extension; not a novel scientific discovery or necessarily a new reaction family.
novelty.distinction: Introduces a reagent blank and inverse purity calculation, rather than comparing antacid capacities per gram.
novelty.original_147_note: Original catalogue reviewed as source context through web excerpts; no complete local automated comparison or semantic-novelty certification.

limitations: Degassing must be documented; retained carbonic acid biases the back-titration.
This is a synthetic known-composition sample, not a measured commercial limestone.

experiments.question: Can known analyte spikes distinguish signal response from dilution?
experiments.script:
# MO-008: Standard addition with volume-corrected optical responses
# Design only: predictions below are not measured observations.
register lv3
add v1 water 100mL
add v1 NaNO3 0.01mol
add v1 H2SO4 0.001mol
add v1 CuSO4 0.0005mol
measure v1 uvvis
measure v1 volume
inspect v1
add v1 CuSO4 0.00025mol
dilute v1 5mL
measure v1 uvvis
measure v1 volume
inspect v1
add v1 CuSO4 0.00025mol
dilute v1 5mL
measure v1 uvvis
measure v1 volume
inspect
